Retry from the execution log invokes the original agent and keeps files and session when possible. No pause control. Failure reasons include agent_blocked and missing_config. Dispatched runs fail after 5 minutes. Heartbeat every 15 seconds. Automatic retries only for transient faults (2 attempts, 3 for network interruptions). Transcripts kept.

evidence.finding: Re-read 2026-10-09: Assignment to a squad wakes only the leader, which @-mentions members, records an evaluation and stops. evidence.title: Autopilots
evidence.locator: Create; Execution mode; Run on a schedule; Run from a webhook; Failures, pausing, and deletion; Permissions
evidence.finding: Re-read 2026-10-09: Autopilots use 5-field cron with IANA time zones, several schedules per autopilot, and run-now. Webhook triggers (JSON up to 256 KiB, idempotency key, GitHub, GitLab and generic event inference, event filters, replay). Create-issue and run-only modes. Run-only failures are not retried and the next schedule still fires. Create-issue waits for an offline runtime; run-only is skipped. Manual pause stops schedules, webhooks and run-now. Automatic pause after at least 50 completed or failed runs in 7 days with a 90% failure rate. The page does not say whether runs can overlap.

evidence.title: Security model

evidence.finding: Re-read 2026-10-09: A run executes with the full permissions of the daemon OS user. Multica does not sandbox the filesystem. Approval prompts are answered automatically. Per-run working directories and per-run API tokens are called conveniences, not a boundary. On the default path Codex runs full-access and Claude Code bypasses permission checks; Codex native sandbox is an optional Windows setting.
